description:
Multi-unit SAME-STORE out-the-door estimate: N matching units at one store (for a small fleet or several
family cars). Pass listing_ids you picked, or quantity plus a match (make, model, trim, years, condition, mileage,
body_style, sourced cargo, seats or towing); it picks the store with the lowest total for the cheapest N matching
units (use zip and radius_miles to stay local) and lists alternatives. Each unit's estimated_out_the_door is
exactly what estimate_out_the_door returns for the same buyer location, incentives and financed flag; totals add
them to the cent. No fleet or volume discount, commercial registration or combined buyer's order is modeled.
Synthetic demo listings; estimates are not offers. If no store has N units, returns the stores with the most matches.

body_style.description: suv, sedan, pickup, hatchback, minivan or wagon.
body_style.title: Body Style

buyer_state.description: Buyer's two-letter state for tax and fees.
buyer_state.title: Buyer State

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's ZIP; fills state, county and city.
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

eligible_incentive_labels.description: Conditional incentive labels the buyer qualifies for (per unit).
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

financed.description: True if financed, false for cash, same as estimate_out_the_door.
financed.title: Financed

include_line_items.description: True to include each unit's itemized lines.
include_line_items.title: Include Line Items

listing_ids.description: Optional: 2 to 25 listing ids (dealer_key:VIN) you picked, all at one store.
listing_ids.title: Listing Ids

make.description: Make of the matching units, e.g. Toyota.
make.title: Make

min_cargo_cuft.description: Minimum sourced cargo volume in cu ft.
min_cargo_cuft.title: Min Cargo Cuft

min_payload_lbs.description: Minimum sourced max payload in lbs.
min_payload_lbs.title: Min Payload Lbs

min_tow_lbs.description: Minimum sourced max towing in lbs.
min_tow_lbs.title: Min Tow Lbs

model.description: Model of the matching units, e.g. RAV4.
model.title: Model

quantity.description: How many units, 2 to 25 (omit when passing listing_ids).
quantity.title: Quantity

radius_miles.description: Radius in miles around zip for the stores considered.
radius_miles.title: Radius Miles

store_id.description: Limit to one store, e.g. lakeshorecity-60601.
store_id.title: Store Id

zip.description: Shopper ZIP for the store search radius.
zip.title: Zip

name: quote_same_store_units
